links.label: Software Assurance

links.label: AI/ML Security
links.description: We review AI systems end to end, from training data and MLOps pipelines to model artifacts, inference hardware, and deployed agent loops.

links.label: Application Security
links.description: Deep code, cloud, and architecture review that finds the root cause and the fix that retires the whole bug class.

links.label: Blockchain
links.description: We review every layer of a blockchain system, from smart contracts to nodes and bridges, backed by Slither, Echidna, and Medusa.

links.label: Cryptography
links.description: PhD-level cryptographers who build and break real protocols, from zero-knowledge proofs and MPC to post-quantum migrations.

links.label: Security Engineering
links.description: An embedded team that builds custom security tooling and remediates vulnerabilities across your pipeline, from development through deployment.

links.label: Research & Development
links.description: Multi-year research that uncovers Internet-scale vulnerabilities and turns the findings into open-source tools, papers, and standards.

links.label: Slither
links.description: Static analysis for Solidity and Vyper with built-in detectors and an API for custom checks.

links.label: Echidna
links.description: Property-based fuzzer that throws grammar-driven inputs at Ethereum contracts to falsify your invariants.

links.label: Medusa
links.description: Parallel smart-contract fuzzing built on go-ethereum and designed for large-scale test campaigns.

links.label: Etheno
links.description: JSON-RPC multiplexer and test-integration layer for contract analysis tools.

links.label: Tealer
links.description: Static analysis for Algorand TEAL programs with CFG construction and vulnerability detectors.

links.label: Circomspect
links.description: Static analysis and linting for Circom circuits, aimed at catching risky patterns in zero-knowledge code.

links.label: Remill
links.description: Machine-code lifter that translates instructions into LLVM bitcode for later analysis and transformation.

links.label: Anvill
links.description: Lifting primitives that aim for Clang-like bitcode quality so decompiled output is easier to reason about.

links.label: VMill
links.description: Snapshot-based process emulator for executing lifted binaries and instrumenting them in LLVM form.

links.label: Manticore
links.description: Symbolic execution engine for binaries, smart contracts, and WebAssembly programs.

links.label: Maat
links.description: Dynamic symbolic execution and binary-analysis framework with taint analysis, environment simulation, and constraint solving.

links.label: Codex Decompiler
links.description: Ghidra plugin that uses language models to improve decompilation and reverse-engineering workflows.

links.label: DeepState
links.description: Common interface for C and C++ tests across multiple fuzzing and symbolic-execution backends.

links.label: gosentry
links.description: Security-focused Go toolchain fork that adds LibAFL fuzzing, structured inputs, grammar mode, and fuzz-time bug detectors.

links.label: zfuzz
links.description: Emulation-based snapshot fuzzer that can load arbitrary memory dumps and attack them directly.

links.label: KRF
links.description: Kernel fault-injection tool for Linux and FreeBSD designed to force error paths and expose weak handling.

links.label: ProtoFuzz
links.description: Grammar-aware fuzzer for Protocol Buffers that derives inputs from format definitions rather than hand-written generators.

links.label: test-fuzz
links.description: Rust macros and Cargo tooling that automate corpus creation and harness setup for fuzzing.

links.label: Necessist
links.description: Mutation-style tool that removes statements and calls to uncover tests that look healthy but are actually weak.

links.label: Mewt
links.description: Mutation testing framework that makes small source-code changes and runs your test suite to show whether tests catch real behavioral changes.

links.label: rekor-monitor
links.description: Transparency-log monitoring for Sigstore's Rekor so maintainers can watch for suspicious signing events.

links.label: It-Depends
links.description: Dependency-graph and SBOM builder for packages and arbitrary source repositories.

links.label: cargo-unmaintained
links.description: Identifies unmaintained packages in Rust projects before they quietly become inherited risk.

links.label: Dylint
links.description: Runs custom Rust lints from dynamic libraries rather than a single fixed lint set.

links.label: semgrep-rules
links.description: Public Semgrep queries developed during audits, research, and internal engineering work.

links.label: codeql-queries
links.description: Public CodeQL query packs used to express deeper code and data-flow policies.

links.label: Linuxevents
links.description: eBPF-based monitoring without shipping kernel headers or a stack of environment-specific bytecode artifacts.

links.label: ebpfpub
links.description: Monitors system and library calls across multiple kernel versions with minimal runtime dependencies.

links.label: ebpf-verifier
links.description: Research prototype for running the eBPF verifier outside the live kernel to make cross-version testing practical.

links.label: mquire
links.description: Memory-forensics tool that queries Linux kernel snapshots over SQL, using BTF and kallsyms embedded in the dump so no external debug symbols are needed.

links.label: winchecksec
links.description: Static inspection of Windows binaries for mitigations like DEP, ASLR, and code integrity.

links.label: pe-parse
links.description: Minimal, security-focused parser for Portable Executable files built to survive malicious or malformed inputs.

links.label: osquery-extensions
links.description: Collection of Trail of Bits extensions that expand what osquery can inspect and expose.

links.label: Graphtage
links.description: Semantic diff and merge tooling for tree-shaped data such as JSON, YAML, HTML, plist, and CSS.

links.label: Polyfile
links.description: Maps the semantic structure of files, including polyglots and other intentionally confusing inputs.

links.label: PolyTracker
links.description: LLVM-based data-flow and control-flow analysis that records how program logic touches specific input bytes.

links.label: Umberto
links.description: Structured-data mutator for JSON, XML, X.509, and other grammar-shaped inputs.

links.label: mishegos
links.description: Differential fuzzer for x86 decoders built to expose disagreements between analysis tools.

links.label: Honeybee
links.description: Intel Processor Trace capture and decoding suite tuned for high-throughput source and blackbox fuzzing.

links.label: Fickling
links.description: Decompiles, statically analyzes, and rewrites Python pickle files to catch code hidden in ML model artifacts.

links.label: PrivacyRaven
links.description: Privacy-testing library for deep-learning systems and privacy-preserving ML techniques.

links.label: MPC-learning
links.description: Multi-party computation library for machine-learning workflows built around a three-party protocol.

links.label: abi3audit
links.description: Scans Python extensions and wheels for abi3 compatibility violations across package histories.

links.label: CVEdb
links.description: Library and CLI for consuming NVD data directly without leaning on third-party APIs.
